parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds all other components such as doors, drawers, and base in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartment when opened and closes to conceal the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden panel similar to the right door, attached with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the left side of the storage compartment and closes to protect the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right drawer is a sliding storage compartment made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a small enclosed space for storing items that need to be easily accessible.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Drawer (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left drawer is a sliding compartment similar to the right drawer, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for small items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails for access.
